user.title: Connect to ComfortClick
user.description: Certificate verification is off by default for compatibility with local controllers using self-signed or invalid certificates. Enable it when your controller has a trusted certificate. Without verification, credentials and commands can be intercepted.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the controller.
error.ssl_error: The certificate could not be verified. Use a trusted certificate matching the controller URL, or disable verification only for a trusted local controller.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log.

init.title: ComfortClick configuration
init.description: Configure multiple fans, air conditioners and utility meters. Existing YAML mappings remain active until you save changes to that category.

connection.title: ComfortClick connection
connection.description: Certificate verification is off unless you enable it. Enable it when your controller has a trusted certificate. Saving reloads the integration. Existing entity mappings are preserved.

mapping.title: Manage mappings

confirm_remove.title: Remove {name}?
confirm_remove.description: This stops providing this entity. Its registry entry and recorded history are retained; they are not deleted.

fan.title: Fan mapping
fan.description: Choose a cached ComfortClick device path or type one manually. No device commands are sent while configuring. Saving reloads the integration. This fan uses a boolean lock, a boolean heating state, a numeric fan level and two temperature readings.

thermostat.title: Air conditioner mapping
thermostat.description: Choose a cached ComfortClick device path or type one manually. No device commands are sent while configuring. Saving reloads the integration. Leave the fan level path empty for a heating-only thermostat. All temperatures are in Celsius.

utility.title: Utility meter mapping
utility.description: Choose a cached ComfortClick device path or type one manually. No device commands are sent while configuring. Saving reloads the integration. Map cumulative totals, not instantaneous power or flow. Default units are m³ for water, kWh for electricity and MWh for heating. Select the unit reported by the controller; this does not rescale the raw reading.

fans.title: Fans
fans.description: Fix the YAML configuration and submit to retry loading the mappings.

thermostats.title: Air conditioners
thermostats.description: Fix the YAML configuration and submit to retry loading the mappings.

utilities.title: Metrics
utilities.description: Fix the YAML configuration and submit to retry loading the mappings.

error.duplicate_path: This controller path is already mapped in this category. Edit the existing mapping instead.
error.invalid_number: Enter a finite number. The temperature step must be greater than zero.
error.invalid_range: The maximum temperature must be greater than the minimum.
error.invalid_unit: Select a water unit for water, or an energy unit for electricity and heating.
error.cannot_load_mappings: Unable to read the mappings. Check comfortclick_custom.yaml for invalid YAML or an invalid category list, then retry.
error.incompatible_meter_type: Water and energy meters cannot share the same history. Add a separate meter mapping for this type.

abort.mappings_changed: These mappings changed in another configuration window. Reopen Configure to use the latest values.
